note: Prompt Lab templates. {curly} placeholders become input fields. Tuning groups append comma-separated style tokens to the final prompt.

templates.name: Cinematic photo
templates.text: Cinematic photograph of {subject}, {environment}, shot on 35mm anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, dramatic composition, photorealistic, highly detailed

templates.name: Studio portrait
templates.text: Professional studio portrait of {subject}, three-point softbox lighting, seamless {backdrop_color} backdrop, 85mm lens, tack-sharp eyes, natural skin texture, editorial quality

templates.name: Product hero shot
templates.text: Premium product photography of {product}, floating on a {surface} with soft reflections, dramatic rim lighting, minimalist composition, advertising quality, 8k detail

templates.name: Isometric icon
templates.text: Isometric 3D icon of {subject}, soft studio lighting, pastel {color_scheme} palette, smooth rounded forms, subtle ambient occlusion, rendered in a clean stylized look, centered on plain background

templates.name: Epic landscape
templates.text: Breathtaking landscape photograph of {location} at {time_of_day}, volumetric light, atmospheric haze, ultra-wide composition with strong foreground interest, National Geographic quality

templates.name: Drone establishing shot
templates.text: Sweeping aerial drone shot flying over {location}, {time_of_day} light, smooth cinematic camera movement slowly revealing {reveal}, atmospheric depth, film grain

templates.name: Character action
templates.text: {character} {action} in {environment}, dynamic tracking shot, dramatic lighting, motion blur on fast movement, cinematic color grade, coherent physics

templates.name: Timelapse
templates.text: Timelapse of {subject} over {duration_description}, locked-off tripod framing, streaking clouds and light trails, smooth exposure ramping, crisp detail

templates.name: Macro detail
templates.text: Extreme macro shot slowly pushing in on {subject}, razor-thin focus plane drifting across intricate surface detail, soft specular highlights, meditative pacing
